name: KOBAY
recent: Kobay 在截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度录得营收 1.302 亿令吉、净利 1,866 万令吉，净利同比增 73.3%。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日召开第 32 届常年股东大会，议程包括派发每股 3.0 仙首次及末期股息、续用股份回购授权及股东授权关联交易。此外，公司多次公告与 UA Materials 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出股东授权上限。
notable: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度净利 1,866 万令吉，同比增 73.3%，营收 1.302 亿令吉，同比增 17.5%。
将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日召开第 32 届常年股东大会。
与 UA Materials 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出股东授权上限，涉及 Paradigm Precision Components、Kual Technologies 及 Paradigm Metal Industries。
risks: 与 UA Materials 的经常性关联交易实际金额多次超出股东授权上限，公司需持续披露并寻求股东更新授权。
董事及大股东 Kobay Holdings 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月间多次申报权益变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度营收 1.302 亿令吉，环比微降 0.3%，同比增 17.5%；净利 1,866 万令吉，环比增 49.5%，同比增 73.3%；净利率 14.3%，高于上期的 9.6%。

recent_en: Kobay reported revenue of RM130.2 million and net profit of RM18.66 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up 73.3% year-on-year. Separately, the company announced several times that actual recurrent related party transactions with UA Materials exceeded the mandated limits.
notable_en: Net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 was RM18.66 million, up 73.3% year-on-year, on revenue of RM130.2 million, up 17.5% year-on-year.
32nd AGM to be held on 4 December 2026, with a proposed first and final single-tier dividend of 3.0 sen per share for FY2026.
Actual recurrent related party transactions with UA Materials exceeded the shareholders' mandate, involving Paradigm Precision Components, Kual Technologies and Paradigm Metal Industries.
risks_en: Actual recurrent related party transactions with UA Materials repeatedly exceeded the shareholders' mandate, requiring ongoing disclosure and renewed shareholder approval.
Directors and major shareholder Kobay Holdings filed multiple changes in interest between September and October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM130.2 million, down 0.3% quarter-on-quarter but up 17.5% year-on-year; net profit was RM18.66 million, up 49.5% quarter-on-quarter and 73.3% year-on-year; net margin was 14.3% versus 9.6% previously.
